name: mcp-client
label: MCP Client
description: Call tools on an external MCP server deterministically, without an LLM.

serverUrl.label: Server URL
serverUrl.description: The MCP server endpoint, e.g. https://example.com/mcp. The host only, without https://, such as name.example.com.

apiKeyHeader.label: API Key Header Name
apiKeyHeader.description: Header carrying the API key, e.g. "x-api-key". Used when Authentication is "API Key".

headers.label: Custom Headers
headers.description: A JSON object of header name/value pairs, e.g. {"x-tenant": "acme"}. Used when Authentication is "Custom Headers".

call-tool.label: Call Tool
call-tool.description: Invoke a specific tool on an external MCP server and return its result.

tool.label: Tool
tool.description: The tool to call. The list is loaded from the MCP server.
